% M2 smoke sample (plain TeX, no format macros).
% Exercises ligatures, kern pairs, Knuth-Plass line breaking,
% \hrule, and a forced page break.

Office hours with affluent staff often find the waffle of afflicted
officials harder to decipher than a stiff fiddle.

\hrule

AVAST! To We AVA. The kerning pairs above should pull glyphs together.

Line wrapping proof: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while
the office fixture flickers in the afternoon, a ruffle of paper on the
desk and a waffle of coffee staining the affidavit left behind by an
afflicted officer who had to leave in a stiff hurry.

\eject

Second page. Another round of fi, fl, ff, ffi words: office, fluffy,
affair, affix, afflict. AVA To We kern triggers repeat. A horizontal
rule follows below.

\hrule

End of smoke sample.
\bye
